name: Dental clinics

problems.words: People get a full treatment quote and then just disappear
quick_ideas: List the last month's treatment quotes by reference and status, so you know how many are waiting
Call back those who said they'll think about it, with their permission, so the quote isn't forgotten.

workzap_build.text: a treatment-plan pipeline (quoted, accepted, in progress, paused, completed) that creates follow-up tasks for reception automatically and shows acceptance by dentist and branch, with no clinical details in messages.

problems.ask_first: Which treatments are you quoting most, implants, braces or cosmetic work?
problems.free_stops: Follow-up timing and stages are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Chairs sit empty in the mornings and we're overbooked after 6
quick_ideas: Map one week of chair bookings by hour, so the real gaps show
Offer morning slots first to flexible patients, so evenings ease.

workzap_build.text: a chair-wise calendar with WhatsApp booking, automatic reminders and a waitlist that fills cancellations, with chair use measured daily.

problems.ask_first: Are your dentists available in the mornings?
problems.free_stops: Slot lengths and waitlist rules are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Braces patients stop paying instalments halfway through
quick_ideas: List every open instalment plan with balance and next due date, so overdue ones stand out
Agree a written schedule with each new plan, so dates are clear from the start.

workzap_build.text: an instalment tracker that sends due-date reminders, with the patient's permission and showing only amount and date, plus an overdue list for the manager.

problems.ask_first: Do patients pay at the counter or by transfer?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and overdue steps are detailed in the solution document.

problems.words: We send crowns to the lab and lose track of which case is where
quick_ideas: Start a lab book with case reference, lab and due date, so late cases are visible
Note the reason for each remake, so you can raise it with the lab.

workzap_build.text: a lab case tracker with sent, due, received and remake status, alerts on late cases, lab-wise remake counts and invoice matching.

problems.ask_first: Do you use one dental lab or several?
problems.free_stops: The tracking fields and invoice match are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Associate dentists argue about their percentage every month
quick_ideas: Put each dentist's split and what counts as production on one signed page, so there is one reference
Decide how lab costs and remakes are treated, so they stop causing arguments.

workzap_build.text: a production and commission statement generated automatically from completed procedures and the agreed rules.

problems.ask_first: Is commission on work done or fees collected?
problems.free_stops: How the rules are encoded stays for the solution document.

problems.words: Recall reminders don't go out so patients only come when in pain
quick_ideas: Pull a list of patients overdue for a check-up who agreed to reminders, so you see the size of the gap
Ask patients at checkout if they want a check-up reminder, so permission is collected.

workzap_build.text: a recall engine that reminds consenting patients on schedule from their last visit date, with no treatment details, and tracks who rebooked.

problems.ask_first: Are last-visit dates kept in software or on paper?
problems.free_stops: Recall intervals and message flow are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Instagram brings messages but the reception replies hours later
quick_ideas: Check how long last week's DMs waited for a reply, so the delay is measured once
Give one person fixed times to answer DMs, so they have an owner.

workzap_build.text: attribution_codes — one inbox for Instagram, Facebook, Google and WhatsApp with response timers and source tracking, showing which channel fills chairs.

problems.ask_first: Who answers the DMs at the moment?
problems.free_stops: Routing and tracking set-up is kept for the solution document.

quick_ideas: Share one price list across branches, so quotes match
Ask for a reason on each discount this week, so you see how often it happens.

workzap_build.text: workflow_automation — a daily cash and card close listing every discount with its approver role, across branches.

problems.ask_first: Do both branches use the same price list now?
problems.free_stops: Approval levels and the close format are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Implant components are expensive and I can't account for all of them
quick_ideas: Do one count of implant parts against what was used, so the gap is known
Keep them in one locked place, so access is limited.

workzap_build.text: a materials and implant register with lot numbers, minimum levels and usage per case reference, with mismatches flagged.

problems.ask_first: Who has access to implant stock today?
problems.free_stops: The register design and checks are in the solution document.

problems.words: Patient photos for marketing are on staff personal phones
quick_ideas: Move marketing photos to one clinic-controlled folder, so they leave personal phones
Ask your lawyer what consent and storage rules apply, so you know the requirement.

workzap_build.text: a consented-photo store with access control, replacing personal phones.

problems.ask_first: Do you collect written consent for marketing photos now?
problems.free_stops: Access rules and storage set-up are in the solution document.

never_say: Whether a treatment was needed, suitable or done well.
Anything on sterilisation standards, radiation safety or materials.
Suggestions to bill insurers for work not done, split invoices or back-date treatment.
Legal views on photo consent; point to a lawyer.
Ideas that send treatment details to patients in messages.
Promises that follow-ups will turn a set share of quotes into treatment.

sample_reply.person: We quote a lot of implant and braces cases but most never start. How can we fix this?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, there's a clear way to get a grip on this, starting this week. 1) List last month's quotes by reference and status, so you know how many are still waiting. 2) Call back the patients who said they'd think about it, with their permission, so no quote is simply forgotten. Workzap can do this automatically for you with a treatment-plan pipeline that creates follow-up tasks for reception and shows how many quotes become treatment. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're welcome to say no.
